e. Recall that sampling theory allows a reasonably large sample to stand in for the true
population distribution. When resampling from the sample for bootstrapping purposes, we
generally do so with replacement. Why with replacement instead of without?

resamples of a size larger than the original sample, and when the size of the resample is
